# FerroFED

> FerroFED is a pure-Rust openEHR federation gateway, one of the FerroHEALTH family. It is a transparent ITS-REST intermediary: a client sends it an ordinary AQL query with no federation syntax and gets back an ordinary ITS-REST result set whose `meta.federation` names each node with its status. The gateway resolves the patient outside AQL through an identifier cross-reference service, sends standard AQL to each node scoped to that node's own EHR id, so no request the gateway composes for a node carries a directly identifying patient identifier, and merges the answers with each node's provenance. It routes follow-up reads and writes to the node that owns them, sends definition requests to the node a client names, and holds stored queries itself. It holds no clinical data of its own. Since v0.0.8 it authenticates every client with an access token from an issuer the operator trusts, authenticates to each node as itself with OAuth 2.0 or a static credential, and tells each node who is asking in a token it signs. It implements the openEHR Federation Working Group's Federation Tier with AQL specification, a release candidate at v0.9.0. Each release ships signed Linux binaries and the container image `ghcr.io/ferrohealth/ferrofed`. Its manufacturer is Cadasto B.V., Comeniusstraat 2d, 1817 MS Alkmaar, The Netherlands, info@cadasto.com. The European interoperability and logging components of the EHDS Regulation are not built yet. FerroFED ships no AI: no model is trained, embedded, or called at request time. AI coding assistance is used to build it, under human review.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/README.md): what FerroFED is, and the licence.
- [Vendored specifications](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/tree/main/docs/specs): the specifications and other upstream corpora FerroFED is built against, from the Federation Tier specification and its reference implementation to openEHR, IHE and HL7 Europe, each with its provenance.
- [Documentation](https://ferrofed.eu/docs/): the book, by reader intent: Evaluate, Operate, Integrate, Contribute.

## The specification

- [Federation Tier with AQL (rendered)](https://syntaric.github.io/openehr-federation-spec/): the governing text.
- [Specification source](https://github.com/syntaric/openehr-federation-spec): the AsciiDoc pages, the two JSON Schemas, the conformance points.
- [Reference implementation](https://github.com/syntaric/openehr-federation-ref): prior art and evidence, never an oracle.

## Governance and policies

- [AI statement](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/AI_STATEMENT.md): how AI tools are used to develop FerroFED, and the fact that the product ships no AI.
- [Governance](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md): how decisions get made, and by whom.
- [Maintainers](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md): the roster and the access-continuity answer.
- [Licensing](https://ferrofed.eu/docs/evaluate/licensing.html): what the licence allows. A commercial licence is arranged with Cadasto B.V., the Licensor, which handles the business side: info@cadasto.com or https://www.cadasto.com/contact/. Technical questions go to the maintainer.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, gates, and the hard rules.
- [Support](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): where to get help.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/SECURITY.md): report a vulnerability privately.
- [Complaints and incidents](https://ferrofed.eu/docs/evaluate/post-market.html): the manufacturer's complaint channel, its registers, corrective action and serious-incident reporting under Regulation (EU) 2025/327.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroFED/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): every change with a user-visible effect.
